title: Chapter 463
paragraphs: Chapter 463
Episode 131: People with good instincts, people with not-so-good instincts (7)
Swoosh!
As soon as Amela finished speaking, blade-like things burst out from the clumped fog behind her. Jin and Murakan easily dodged them, as if they had expected it.
'I knew she would have a similar demeanor to Lady Yona, but she seems a little crazier than I expected.'
Fog blades were embedded in the spot where Jin and Murakan had been standing. Just by looking at the way the ground was sliced like water, it was clear that the attack wasn't just a threat.
Murakan was about to reflexively counterattack but held back his power. He remembered Jin's words to only defend and dodge until communication with Amela was established.
'Ugh, it's annoying just trying to dodge.'
Less than 5 seconds had passed when over a hundred blades dropped, targeting Jin and Murakan.
And Amela was merely sitting in place, controlling it all with just her eye and hand movements.
'It's as if she's become the god of this space.'
Jin thought as he struck down a fog blade that flew right in front of his nose. The shattered fragments of the blade didn't fall to the ground but flew back towards Jin.
It was something that couldn't be done with Aura or magic. It was a movement that could only be possible with a special kind of power, the power of chaos.
"Heh, dodging? Fast, huh? Let's see if you can keep dodging!"
The number of blades formed in the air began to increase rapidly. Roughly twice as many blades were pressing Jin and Murakan from all sides.
When they managed to dodge or break them all with their bare hands, Amela rolled her foot in frustration.
At that moment, the entire space began to vibrate unstably, as if it was about to collapse, and the blades multiplied again, reaching over 500.
Swoosh!
It was impossible for even Jin to dodge and strike down that many blades with his bare body, so he pulled out Sigmund.
"See? You can't just hold back when you're mad, can you?"
"I took it out to defend, so just hold on a little longer."
Shaaa-! Over 500 blades fired all at once, covering Jin and Murakan's figures.
However, the next moment, Jin unfolded a combination of the King's Sword Technique Waterfall and Lightning Slash, shattering all the fog blades.
Whether when Jin and Murakan first entered this space or when they so effortlessly shattered the fog now, Amela couldn't help but be flustered.
'Why aren't they affected? Why aren't they going crazy?'
She still didn't know that Jin was a contractor of Soldelet.
To be exact, she didn't even know that the men in front of her were Jin Runcandel and the Black Dragon Murakan, nor did she know what kind of commotion they had recently caused in the world.
In other words, Amela really had no interest in worldly affairs. Just as her previous life's Valeria had described.
"I am Jin Runcandel of the 12th generation of Runcandel."
[You're from Runcandel?]
"Indeed."
[But I still can't spare your lives.]

Already outside, under the curse, Jipul and Kinjelo had killed each other, and the number of royal troops exceeded a thousand. If Amella had cared about the aftermath, she wouldn't have done such a thing in the first place.
"You seem even more ruthless than the rumors."
As soon as he responded, the shape of the floating knives in the air began to change and distort.
In an instant, the transformed Taki now resembled cannons instead of knife blades.
'Cannons?'
Cannon barrels, which could be seen in large-scale wars, were all aimed at Jin and Murakan.
Pebble-! Boom… Pebble…!
Unlike regular cannons, the Taki cannons didn't need to reload. Amella's will continuously formed and fired ammunition without rest.

The cannons shelling the protective shield made it impossible to see what was ahead. To break through these cannons, one would need to use a divine weapon or a decisive weapon, or something equivalent.
'But doing so could put Rata, Pay, and the others at risk.'
Bubar was a soulless feeling, and even if he was harmed, there was no need to worry. However, whether Amella would protect her beloved toys in extreme situations was uncertain.
'I wanted to solve any issues with the Demon King's Sword if I could.'
Divine energy.

The initial reason Jin pulled out Sigmund instead of Bradamante was due to habit (trying to expose the divine weapon as little as possible to his opponents), but it was also because of his experience.
-I lose my reason when I see divine energy. You don't have to feel sorry because I didn't explain it. Hehe, I thought my youngest would at least hide that power from me until he becomes a knight…
As a prospective knight, Yona almost killed her beloved youngest sibling upon encountering Jin's divine energy.
There was no guarantee that Amella would react the same way as Yona, but it wouldn't hurt to be cautious. Jin came to find her to make her an ally.
However, at this point, Jin had no choice. He had never considered that conversation would be this impossible.
The bombardment stopped for a moment.
It wasn't because Amella was tired that she stopped. It was to see if Jin and Murakan were finished.
[I'm fed up, you're so tenacious! When I show you that I'm trying this hard, shouldn't you just die?]
Of course, the two of them were standing perfectly fine. The protective shield, expanded by Aura, was severely damaged and poured down like a worn-out rag, but that was all.
Jin and Amella's gazes collided.
"You seem too comfortable to say that you've made an effort. You're not even out of breath."
While Jin and Murakan had used their energy to create the protective shield, Amella's Taki remained completely unspent, even after firing so many cannons.
"Right. My power is infinite here. So, how about we both stop exerting ourselves and end this amicably? I'm telling you in advance, you won't be able to hurt me with that strange lightning sword."
Suddenly, a dagger was formed in Amella's hand.

'It's fascinating. It seems she can form anything with her energy. Moreover, it's here in this place. As I suspected, there must be some special effect that temporarily grants Amella transcendent power.'
And without any hesitation, Amella cut off her own left wrist with the dagger.
However, instead of blood, a smoky energy flowed from the severed wrist and a new one was immediately formed.
"You're quite resilient, Lady Amella."
Murakan shook his head as if he couldn't believe it.
"Originally, such rapid regeneration was a specialty of demons or devils, but now even humans can do it. Hey, hey. You said your name was Amella? Don't rely on that and end up dead for real."

"If we engage in a battle of attrition, you two will be the ones to die anyway. I just want to give you a chance to die comfortably. I also wish you would stop bothering my precious time with our cute little ones."
"I have shown you the utmost courtesy so far, Amella. So, let me ask you one last thing. Among those currently in the Gaipa Army, is there a faction that has agreed to join forces with you?"
The battle outside continued between the giant figure of Bubar, controlled by Amella, and the four major factions, but he asked on purpose.
Considering her personality, even if she formed an alliance, it wouldn't be surprising if she didn't stop attacking because it was annoying.
"What would you do with that information?"
"I came here to capture you just like the others outside. I heard that you travel and explore the world, searching for something. I think it might be related to this dark energy, chaos."
"You know about chaos?"
"Not really."
"Then, we cannot be friends."
Jin's gaze turned to Bubar's soul, which was punching the air and panting in the void.
"So, did you become friends with Bubar Gaston?"
He asked in a soft tone as if asking a child. Jin thought that Bubar had come with Kinzelo and was captured until just a moment ago.
However, unlike the Prochi siblings, Bubar appeared to only have a soul-like presence, which led him to think that might not be the case.
'Kinzelo probably knows much more about chaos than I do. That soul-like Bubar might be a form of chaos or a fragment of it, and that could be what amplified Amella's power.'
Amella nodded slowly with some hesitation.
"That's... how it is."
She reluctantly seemed to affirm. It appeared that she had no choice but to become friends due to the information on chaos, but in reality, she didn't really want to get close to him.
Hearing her answer, Jin's eyes grew cold.
"So, you belong to Kinzelo's faction."
"I'm not sure about that... Wait, why do I have to be interrogated like this by you? Just kill me already!"
"To kill or not... That's what I've been trying to figure out, mercenary Amella."
Creak, creak...!
Cracks suddenly appeared on the ground where Jin was standing. As he gathered his energy, the air around him became heavy in an instant.
And the shining blade of Bradamante emerged from its sheath.
From the beginning, Jin didn't come to this land with the premise of 'unconditionally capturing' Amella.
"-We must capture her. If that's impossible, we must at least restrain her for sure."
As he told Balkas, he was considering the possibility of her becoming an enemy.
Restraint, he intended to decide based on her power and abilities.
For example, whether to kill her, spare her, keep her from fighting at the forefront of the enemies, or not restrain her at all.
With this level of ability, killing her was the obvious choice.
If in the future, Runkandel faces a full-scale battle with Kinzelo, and Amella takes to the battlefield with power close to infinity like now.
How many Runkandelians would die then? To avoid such a future, Amella had to be killed.

"Although I didn't receive any hospitality when I visited your land, I don't hold any particular grudge. Even if you had refused my offer more politely, my choice wouldn't have changed if you became friends with my enemies. I don't think there's any reason to hold a grudge."
Whooosh-!
Bradamante was dyed black with spirit energy.
At that moment, Amella couldn't help but widen her eyes in shock.
'Wha... spirit energy!? Could it be, he's from Solderet...!'
She quickly reacted to Jin's movements and began to shoot her energy at him.
However, Jin, protected by his spirit energy armor, pierced through her barrage and swung Bradamante at Amella.
